capabilities.name: Controlled Terminology Evaluation Pack
capabilities.responsibility: Execute deterministic terminology-resolution cases through the governed terminology orchestration gate and fail when observed READY/BLOCKED outcomes, reasons or canonical bindings diverge from the controlled expectations.
capabilities.authority_role: Evaluation-only authority over the controlled terminology pack; it verifies governed terminology behaviour but does not perform fuzzy matching, semantic inference, ranking, recommendation or LLM generation.
safety_invariants: Blocked terminology outcomes may not advance.
Observed status, reason codes and canonical concept bindings must exactly match the controlled case expectations.
The pack invokes the existing governed terminology gate rather than duplicating terminology resolution logic.
capabilities.notes: Specialized deterministic evaluation capability for the governed terminology chain.
